desc: Ideation: f(r) = max min(a,b) over pairs with max(a,b) <= r; valid count = sum_r (r - f(r)); gain only where pair is unique max; answer = base + max gain.
Resolve duplicate-pair handling: track second-best *value* (not second-best index) so duplicate copies yield zero gain.
Implement the sweep solution in the starter code (O(n + m) time, O(n + m) space, Python int handles large answers).
Verify on examples (9 and 12 confirmed), duplicate-pair edge case (gain 0), single-pair case (removal yields all n(n+1)/2 subarrays), and brute-force reasoning cross-check.
